flags.title: Sector tailwind
flags.note: Consumer Durables is in a TAILWIND (tailwind score +0.80) — the macro backdrop supports the setup.
flags.lesson: Focus on cycles and change, not insider chatter (the author's actual edge).

strengths.point: Promoters hold a controlling majority - skin in the game.
Consumer Durables is in a tailwind - the macro backdrop is supportive.

weaknesses.point: The share price has run ahead of the fundamentals.
Institutional money has been flowing out.
weaknesses.evidence: NEGATIVE MONEY FLOW - institutional holding change -0.13 pp

weaknesses.point: Foreign institutions have been cutting their stake.

opportunities.point: A consumer durables tailwind can lift earnings without the company doing anything different.
India's jewellery market is growing at a 16% CAGR, expanding from USD 80 Bn in 2024 to USD 145 Bn by 2028.
opportunities.evidence: Demand outlook: "India’s jewellery market is growing at a 16% CAGR, expanding from USD 80 Bn in 2024 to USD 145 Bn by 2028." (concall ppt - 2026-02-01)

opportunities.point: Demand trends during the fiscal year were supported by a recovery in consumer spending across key global markets.
opportunities.evidence: Demand outlook: "Demand trends during FY 2024–25 were supported by a recovery in consumer spending in key markets, notably the United States, China, the Middle East, and parts of Europe, alongside resilient purchasing in emerging economies." (annual report - 2025-03-31)

opportunities.point: The company has an extensive portfolio of 2,367 jewellery designs, with an average product price at INR 62,045.
opportunities.evidence: Orders / capacity: "Extensive portfolio of 2,367 jewellery designs, with Average Product Price at INR 62,045" (concall ppt - 2026-02-01)

opportunities.point: The company is committed to spending the unspent CSR amount within 6 months from the end of the financial year.
opportunities.evidence: Management commitment: "The Company is committed to spending this unspent amount within 6 months from the end of this financial year in compliance with Section 135 of the Companies Act, 2013." (annual report - 2025-03-31)

opportunities.point: The board did not recommend any dividend on equity shares for the financial year under review.
opportunities.evidence: Capital allocation: "Your Board does not recommend any Dividend on Equity Shares for the Financial Year under review." (annual report - 2025-03-31)

opportunities.point: The company raised 7,893.90 lakhs through a fresh SME IPO issue of 5,37,000 equity shares.
opportunities.evidence: Capital allocation: "Between the end of the financial year of the Company to which financial statements relates and the date of the report, the Company raised ₹7893.90 lakhs by issuing 53,70,000 fresh Equity Shares at an issue price of ₹147 per share, which included a premium of..." (annual report - 2025-03-31)

opportunities.point: The industry navigated challenges including high import duties on gold, precious metal price volatility, and rising compliance costs.
opportunities.evidence: Margins / costs: "The industry, however, continued to navigate challenges including high import duties on gold, volatility in precious metal prices, and rising regulatory compliance costs." (annual report - 2025-03-31)

threats.point: A price that has outrun earnings needs the growth to catch up or it de-rates.
Geopolitical tensions, mine production constraints, and trade policies influenced raw material availability and pricing globally.
threats.evidence: Risk disclosed in the filings: "On the supply side, geopolitical tensions, mine production constraints, and changing trade policies influenced raw material availability and pricing." (annual report - 2025-03-31)

threats.point: Volatility in precious metal prices and import duties influenced procurement strategies and working capital requirements.
threats.evidence: Risk disclosed in the filings: "On the supply side, volatility in gold and diamond prices, combined with elevated import duties, influenced procurement strategies and working capital requirements." (annual report - 2025-03-31)

threats.point: The jewellery industry is subject to risks like precious metal price volatility, import duties, and foreign exchange fluctuations.
threats.evidence: Risk disclosed in the filings: "The jewellery industry remains subject to multiple risks, including volatility in gold, silver, and diamond prices, which can impact both consumer sentiment and the Company’s procurement costs." (annual report - 2025-03-31)

swot.verdict: Opportunities dominate the evidence (S4/W7/O13/T8), led by 'A consumer durables tailwind can lift earnings without the company doing anything different', so the case leans on things that are not in the reported numbers yet.
